headers.name: Authorization

server.name: io.github.bobaba99/motionlint
server.description: Catch bad animations before they ship. Deterministic motion audit + vision-LLM design review.
server.title: MotionLint

packageArguments.description: Starts MotionLint in MCP stdio server mode.

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for vision-LLM review. Optional — the deterministic audit needs no key, and Ollama, OpenAI or Google can be used instead.
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for vision-LLM review. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Google API key for vision-LLM review. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the OpenAI base URL to target an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

server.name: io.github.bobbyhouse/append-log-mcp
server.description: A generic append-only log MCP server. Persist timestamped JSON entries and query them by recency.
server.title: Append Log MCP

environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSONL log file inside the container. Defaults to append-log.jsonl in the current working directory.
environmentVariables.name: APPEND_LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to expose. Available: append, query
environmentVariables.name: APPEND_LOG_TOOLS

server.name: io.github.bobbyhouse/project-gutenberg-mcp
server.description: Read Project Gutenberg books via MCP. Search, fetch metadata, and retrieve text in passages.
server.title: Project Gutenberg MCP

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Gutenberg mirror. Run the mirror from the mirror/ directory and point this at it. See the README for setup instructions.
environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to expose. Available: search_books, get_book_metadata, fetch_book_text, list_passages, get_passage
environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Project Gutenberg book ID to use as the default for all tools. Find IDs via search_books. Example: 2680 for Meditations by Marcus Aurelius.
environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_BOOK_ID

environmentVariables.description: Size in bytes of each passage returned by get_passage.
environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_CHUNK_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Default ISO 639-1 language code filter for search_books. Used when the caller omits the language parameter.
environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_LANGUAGE
